decisions.decision: Confirm theme for the event as 'The Room Where It Happens'.

decision_sources.speaker: Unknown
decision_sources.quote:
a.       Committees
                     i.    Wildcard for a passionate director
                    ii.    Science council over UNEP
                    iii.   HOC (Harold?) - US Senate a bit too controversial at the moment
                                1.  Leaning away from current political views
             b.   Jr committees?
             c.   UBC VYMUN or Jr: Sports committee idea (John, Cameron, Nate)
                     i.    Depends on how it plays out - not fantasy football
                    ii.    FIFA council could be acceptable - VMUN had one
                                1.  Another option is Olympic Committee
                    iii.   Don’t want to have to write a whole new backgrounder
                    iv.    UBC could be more suitable
                     v.    Director is Cameron Stanger (Chair: John Huang)
    3.   VYMUN Jr.
             a.   Let the directors decide
             b.   3 committees: general, specialized and crisis
                     i.    Have  to make sure the crisis directors are fully prepared
                    ii.    Harder to manage younger children - timeliness
                    iii.   Has to be more structured and approved
    4.   Conﬁrm theme to put on website
             a.   The Room Where It Happens
                     i.    conﬁrmed!
